ISOLATED_MARGIN.unrealized_pnl_netting: Strictly isolated to individual contract position; zero cross-position netting.
ISOLATED_MARGIN.liquidation_trigger_condition: Isolated Wallet Balance + Position UPnL < Maintenance Margin.
ISOLATED_MARGIN.margin_call_behavior: Passive alert only; no automated collateral injection from cash reserve without API bot.

CROSS_MARGIN.unrealized_pnl_netting: Shared across all USDⓈ-M futures positions within the Futures Wallet.
CROSS_MARGIN.maintenance_margin_formula: Sum of (Notional_i * MMR_i) across all open futures positions.
CROSS_MARGIN.liquidation_trigger_condition: Total Futures Wallet Balance + Total Futures UPnL < Total Maintenance Margin.
CROSS_MARGIN.margin_call_behavior: Cross-position buffer; zero access to external Spot Wallet.

PORTFOLIO_MARGIN.maintenance_margin_formula: Portfolio SPAN Risk Matrix with correlation offsets (up to 85% offset for delta-neutral carry).
PORTFOLIO_MARGIN.liquidation_trigger_condition: Unified Account Net Equity < Unified Portfolio Maintenance Margin.
PORTFOLIO_MARGIN.margin_call_behavior: Automatic internal netting prevents margin calls during market rallies.

HYPOTHETICAL_CROSS_COLLATERAL.maintenance_margin_formula: Theoretical Net Basis Exposure * MMR + Haircut Drag.
HYPOTHETICAL_CROSS_COLLATERAL.liquidation_trigger_condition: Theoretical Net Equity < Theoretical Haircut-Adjusted Margin.
HYPOTHETICAL_CROSS_COLLATERAL.margin_call_behavior: Assumed frictionless auto-rebalancing without operational latency.

spot_collateral_eligibility_verdict: SPOT COLLATERAL INELIGIBILITY CONFIRMED FOR RETAIL ACCOUNTS: On Binance, the Spot Wallet and USDⓈ-M Futures Wallet are segregated ledger environments. In standard Isolated Margin and Cross Margin accounts, physical Spot BTC, ETH, and SOL CANNOT serve as margin for USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts. Even in Multi-Assets Mode, collateral must be held inside the Futures Wallet, which locks the coins and precludes independent Spot trading. Only institutional accounts qualifying for Binance Portfolio Margin (VIP 4+ or $10M+ equity) can pledge Spot balances against perpetual short positions in a unified account. Therefore, standard retail $10k carry strategies CANNOT claim exchange-authentic cross-collateral benefits.

treasury_reconciliation.benchmark_name: 3-Month US Treasury Bill (FRED TB3MS / Treasury Direct Match)
treasury_reconciliation.official_data_source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) & U.S. Department of the Treasury
treasury_reconciliation.credit_risk_attribution: US Sovereign Debt (Zero Default Risk) vs Binance/Tether Private Counterparty Risk
sovereign_vs_crypto_risk_factors: 1. Exchange credit & insolvency risk (Binance custody vs US Treasury full faith and credit).
2. Stablecoin de-peg & reserve backing risk (USDT vs USD legal tender).
3. Operational execution risk (transfer latency, API outages, margin injection delays).
4. Mark-price intrabar spike & liquidation penalty risk.
5. Basis blowout risk (widening Spot-Perp discount during market cascades).
treasury_reconciliation.economic_attractiveness_verdict: MARGINAL SPREAD INSUFFICIENT FOR RISK INCURRED: Over the 425-day holding period, unleveraged safe carry (Structure B) yielded +313.12 to +338.56 USDT, underperforming risk-free US Treasury Bills (+610.88 USDT) by -$272.32 to -$297.76 USDT. Even aggressive Structure A (which suffered margin calls and complete cash reserve exhaustion) generated merely +15.35 to +66.24 USDT in excess return over sovereign debt (< 50 bps annualized spread). Bearing crypto exchange counterparty risk and stablecoin de-peg risk for a 0.50% annualized premium is economically indefensible for rational institutional capital.

turkish_executive_summary:
1. Borsa Sözleşme Analizi: Binance USDⓈ-M izole ve çapraz marjin kuralları gereği, perakende Spot cüzdandaki BTC/ETH/SOL varlıkları vadeli işlem marjinine DAHİL EDİLEMEZ. Spot varlıkların teminat sayıldığı Portföy Marjini (PM Pro) yalnızca VIP 4+ ($10M+) kurumsal hesaplara açıktır; bu nedenle 10.000 USDT sermayeli standart hesaplar için çapraz teminatlama tamamen FARAZİDİR (HYPOTHETICAL_CROSS_COLLATERAL).
2. Likidasyon Rekonstrüksiyonu: 88.378 USDT seviyesindeki BTC likidasyonu kuruşu kuruşuna bağımsız olarak doğrulanmıştır. İhlal anında Spot envanter değeri 10.450,63 USDT, vadeli marjin 0,00 USDT'dir. İhlal anında kapatılırsa net kâr +444,36 USDT (+%4,44), vade sonuna kadar çıplak Spot tutulursa nihai kâr/zarar -31,67 USDT (-%0,32) olmaktadır. Eski -5.000 USDT iddiası resmen hükümsüzdür.
3. ABD Hazine Bonosu Kıyaslaması: 2024 3 aylık Hazine Bonosu yıllık %5,25 getiri ile 425 günde +610,88 USDT risksiz kazanç üretmiştir. Güvenli Yapı B (-272 USDT açık) bonoların fersah fersah gerisinde kalmıştır. Agresif Yapı A ise nakit rezervlerini tamamen tüketerek marjin çağrısı yemiş ve bonoları yalnızca +15 ila +66 USDT (yıllık <%0,5 prim) geçebilmiştir. Borsa iflası, USDT de-peg ve akıllı sözleşme riskleri düşünüldüğünde bu prim iktisadi olarak YETERSİZDİR.
4. Karar Kapısı: HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT_EXCHANGE_EVIDENCE ve ECONOMICALLY_UNATTRACTIVE_UNDER_TESTED_ASSUMPTIONS. APPROVAL4 = FALSE kesin olarak korunmaktadır.
